content:
The test image shows soybean plants with severe yellowing, browning, and dying in field rows. Key observations:
- Whole-plant symptoms across multiple rows
- Progressive yellowing and wilting with leaves dropping
- Patches of heavily affected plants contrasting with healthy green plants in the background
- Brown/dead stems visible

This pattern strongly matches **Sudden Death Syndrome** — the field-level patch pattern, whole-plant yellowing/dying, and characteristic appearance of the dying plants in rows aligns well with the SDS reference collage showing similar field patterns with interveinal chlorosis progressing to plant death.
